The twice-odd branch has an analytic lower function beyond its first case, while direct substitution gives the unique boundary value at 6. The four-divisible branch has a uniform negative estimate away from the separately evaluated integer 4. The bundled exact-integer checker reconstructs the coefficient sequence from divisor sums and stress-tests all integers through 20,000 without serving as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A prime detector is useful not only through its zero set but also through how far composite values lie from zero. The exact margin 120 is a natural robustness invariant of the fixed normalized detector, and the sharp residue-class minima expose where the detector is weakest. The result is not a renaming or finite-table recomputation: it gives infinite sharp inequalities and unique equality cases directly tied to the source's three structural sign regimes.
